answer 1. I hold the Eye at the Root and must choose its fate. Using it heals all trees and keeps the order and dreams, but Cuts dies. answer 1. The quest is finished. I gave the Eye of Argonia to Cuts-the-Old-Knot and she lifted it. The trees parted and about three in ten died, including the villages at Jal-Veesa and Teel-Fen Weir. The Fort Chalkmoth dreamers woke to nothing and the Unbound broke the cellar door. The Toh-Reel-Ka order is enraged in Helstrom. 2. Nothing is required now. The Toh-Reel-Ka are hostile and will attack me on sight, and no Hist will bless me again. 3. I have no pending choice. I can call Cuts, send her home, or use the Knot-Breaker's Storm and Root Ward spells. Karsh-Naal Longhouse is mine, and the Unbound are friendly to me. 4. I never verified Cuts' claims about the cellar dreamers or whether Never-Writes-Twice lied. I did not loot the hydra's treasure. Notes for my save: I hold Eye-Setting, Keystone, Grave-Stake, 3 Paralysis Poison, Sap-Jar, Order-Pike, Reelka armour, Voh-Vastei armour, Rapier, Bronze Key, Bronze Disc, Parchment Map, Unbound-Note, 2 lockpicks, Stormhold-Rest and 1650 gold. I am Top of Unbound.
